units.source_text: 来到箱根，中间歇息一天，以消除疲劳。

en.t: After arriving in Hakone, they rested for a day along the way to recover from their fatigue.

units.source_text: 七月十日，是约定续弈的日子。

en.t: July tenth was the agreed day for resuming the game.

units.source_text: 对局的早晨，大竹七段表情迥异，

en.t: On the morning of the match, Otake 7-dan wore a completely different expression,

units.source_text: 他拉长着脸，紧闭双唇，似乎被惹怒了。

en.t: his face was drawn, his lips were tightly shut, and he seemed to have been angered.

units.source_text: 他摇晃着肩膀，比平日更精神抖擞地在廊道上走动。

en.t: He swung his shoulders as he walked up and down the corridor, looking more vigorous than usual.

units.source_text: 那眼睑鼓起、单眼皮的细长眼睛，放出了无敌无畏的光芒。

en.t: Those narrow, single-lidded eyes with swollen eyelids shone with an invincible and fearless light.
